choices.content: No, the sample is not representative
Yes, basketball team members are also students at the school
Yes, as long as enough people are surveyed

question.prompt: Can measuring only the heights of the school basketball team members represent the whole school? Which of the following answers is correct?

solutions.explanation: Basketball team members are generally taller. The sampling is neither random nor representative, which may make the estimated school average height too high. The correct choice is A.
solutions.title: Identify height-related selection bias
